# IEthVaultWrapperV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/fluid/IEthVaultWrapperV2.sol)

**Title:**
IEthVaultWrapperV2

Interface for the Fluid ETH vault wrapper that swaps ETH<>stETH around deposits and withdrawals


## Functions
### deposit

deposits msg.value as stETH into ETH vault. returns shares amount


```solidity
function deposit(
    string calldata route_,
    bytes calldata swapCalldata_,
    uint256 minStEthIn_,
    address receiver_
)
    external
    payable
    returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`route_`|`string`|Route string through which swap will go, e.g. "1INCH-A"|
|`swapCalldata_`|`bytes`|swap data for ETH -> stETH to call AggregationRouter with|
|`minStEthIn_`|`uint256`|minimum expected stETH to be deposited|
|`receiver_`|`address`|receiver of iToken shares from deposit|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|actual amount of shares received|


### withdraw

withdraws amount_ of stETH from msg.sender as owner and swaps it to ETH then transfers to msg.sender


```solidity
function withdraw(
    string calldata route_,
    uint256 amount_,
    bytes calldata swapCalldata_,
    uint256 minEthOut_,
    address receiver_
)
    external
    returns (uint256 ethAmount_);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`route_`|`string`|Route string through which swap will go, e.g. "1INCH-A"|
|`amount_`|`uint256`|amount of stETH to withdraw|
|`swapCalldata_`|`bytes`|swap data for stETH -> ETH to call AggregationRouter with|
|`minEthOut_`|`uint256`|minimum expected output ETH|
|`receiver_`|`address`|receiver of withdrawn ETH|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ethAmount_`|`uint256`|actual output ETH|


### getWithdrawSwapAmount

gets the amount of stETH that must be swapped to ETH via router for a withdraw


```solidity
function getWithdrawSwapAmount(uint256 amount_) external view returns (uint256 stEthSwapAmount_);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount_`|`uint256`|amount of stETH to withdraw|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`stEthSwapAmount_`|`uint256`|to amount of stEth to be swapped to ETH|


## Errors
### EthVaultWrapper__OutputInsufficient
Thrown when the swap output is below the required minimum


```solidity
error EthVaultWrapper__OutputInsufficient();
```

### EthVaultWrapper__UnexpectedWithdrawAmount
Thrown when the withdrawn amount does not match the expected amount


```solidity
error EthVaultWrapper__UnexpectedWithdrawAmount();
```

### EthVaultWrapper__InvalidInput
Thrown when an input parameter is invalid


```solidity
error EthVaultWrapper__InvalidInput();
```

### EthVaultWrapper__OnlyWhitelisted
Thrown when the caller is not whitelisted


```solidity
error EthVaultWrapper__OnlyWhitelisted();
```

## Structs
### DepositData
Swap parameters for the deposit path (ETH -> stETH)


```solidity
struct DepositData {
    string route;
    bytes swapCalldata;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`route`|`string`|The router route string (e.g. "1INCH-A")|
|`swapCalldata`|`bytes`|The calldata forwarded to the aggregation router|

### WithdrawData
Swap parameters for the withdrawal path (stETH -> ETH)


```solidity
struct WithdrawData {
    string route;
    bytes swapCalldata;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`route`|`string`|The router route string (e.g. "1INCH-A")|
|`swapCalldata`|`bytes`|The calldata forwarded to the aggregation router|
